description: Formal width control for native PAMF-SUP feature expansion, matching the published dataset cohort reconstruction.
authorization: User requested fully supervised PAMF-SUP on the reference data, with 100 epochs, no early augmentation and expansion of the original representations only.

data.dataset: Oxford SatIQ Zenodo 8220494, first 1010464 chronological packets
data.representation: Only 8000-point common-word prefix, resampled to the original 256-point native view before any branch encoding. Existing 11000-point cache unchanged.
data.support_query_ref: Transient source V enrollment K1/16. Independent T (50000) separately staged; no training access.

permissions.claim_scope: Training and development use only L/V native common-word samples. Independent test T remains reserved until the final methods, weights, and scoring protocol are frozen.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Scratch. Frozen epoch 100 is the primary matched-budget comparison. Any other checkpoint selection is source V only, before independent held-out predictions and scoring.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU5 with >=4096 MiB free and <=2 incumbent jobs at admission.

metric_names: individual train CE, MSE and triplet
PAMF within-satellite CE, two view CE, and posterior KL
dimensions: 1375 source K1/K16 reference classes and 12785 matched queries
28225 updates per full epoch, 2822500 updates over 100 epochs

rows.purpose: Controlled fully supervised long-budget baseline for native width.
rows.seed_notes: Shared deterministic class-pair batching and validation references. No synthetic augmentation.
rows.scenario: Oxford native real received, paper-style random message split
rows.budget_ref: 28225 updates per epoch, 2822500 updates total, 903200 distinct labeled records per epoch.

notes: All five original path inputs; same source L/V, no synthetic augmentation, all labels supervised and defined by satellite/beam composite ID.
Same native-width objective and optimizer. The two config differences from the probe JSON are the number of epochs and epoch validation schedule.
Paper reconstruction uses a newly seeded packet shuffle because the authors' exact shuffled IDs are unavailable.
